basis: Judgement of this organisation, mapping each lens question title to the provider-neutral capabilities a design needs to answer it. The lens itself names AWS services; this map deliberately does not. Review it like an ADR: a disputed row gets a reason, not a silent edit.

AGENTOPS01.why: Roles and success criteria need a registry of agents, a measurable criterion and a defined handoff to a human.

AGENTOPS03.why: Deployment needs a runtime, a record of what is deployed, and a gate before release.

AGENTOPS04.why: Tool integration through a standard protocol, managed behind a gateway.

AGENTSEC01.why: Memory and shared state need scoping by agent identity.

AGENTSEC02.why: Tool use is controlled at a gateway, by policy, and isolated when it executes code.

AGENTSEC04.why: Goal alignment through guardrails and human-in-the-loop for critical decisions.

AGENTSEC05.why: Non-repudiation needs an audit trail of every action.

AGENTSEC06.why: Inter-agent communication needs authenticated agents and a defined protocol.

AGENTSEC07.why: Protecting oversight and detecting rogue agents needs approvals, traces and a list of who should exist.

AGENTSEC08.why: Input validation and output filtering, often applied at the gateway.

AGENTSEC09.why: Scanning and penetration testing run as adversarial evals in isolation.

AGENTREL01.why: Reliable development rests on tests and recoverable execution.

AGENTREL02.why: Atomic tasks with predictable outcomes and explicit limits.

AGENTREL03.why: Memory and state remain available through the agent lifecycle.

AGENTREL04.why: Arbiter patterns and capability taxonomies for multi-agent work.

AGENTREL05.why: The right data at the right time.

AGENTREL06.why: Legacy integration with fallbacks and idempotency.

AGENTREL07.why: Recovery through checkpoints and model fallback.

AGENTREL08.why: Graceful degradation to a cheaper model or to a human.

AGENTPERF07.why: Multitenant isolation of runtime and state.

AGENTCOST01.why: Reasoning loop cost is controlled in the harness and made visible.

AGENTCOST05.why: Attribution across multi-agent workflows needs per-run traces.

AGENTSUS02.why: Sustainable dependencies: know what you depend on and keep it movable.

AGENTSUS03.why: Durable patterns with users and business processes keep humans in the loop.
